articles.summary: Cepheus-1-108Q validates Rigetti’s proprietary chiplet-based scaling architecture and is now generally available to Rigetti’s customers and partners via the Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services platform and through Amazon Braket, the quantum computing service by AWS.
articles.title: Rigetti Announces General Availability of 108-Qubit System

articles.summary: BERKELEY, Calif., April 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rigetti Computing, Inc. ("Rigetti" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: RGTI), a pioneer in hybrid quantum-classical computing, announced today that it will release first quarter 2026 results on Monday, May 11, 2026, after market close.
articles.title: Rigetti Computing to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Conference Call on May 11, 2026
